source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 神农旧事，芳华动容
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC12 after EP02 SC11 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the white-clothed woman asking about the Chana Fanghua tune: Tuobaye recounts meeting Shennong on Nanjishan, accepting the deathbed trust, falling into Dragon Pool, and the woman reacting strongly to Shennong's Baicao poison death and the Chana Fanghua song.
title: 神农旧事，芳华动容

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC11 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC11 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH02 sword/sheath action and SH03-SH04 character continuity need production regeneration.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子询问竹笛曲名来历后，拓拔野讲述南际山、神农、临终重托与龙潭经历。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 白衣女子问起刹那芳华曲，拓拔野意识到那是神农临终所唱之曲，便将南际山顶邂逅神农、接受临终重托、从龙牙岩/龙潭一线坠落等经历完整讲给她听。白衣女子听到神农百草毒发、在龙牙岩物化时神色剧变；再听到神农临终高歌刹那芳华曲，眼中重新泛起泪光。短剧改编保持成人拓拔野设定，用回忆影像和当前反应交错表达，不在画面中显示血书内容、歌词、曲名或任何可读文字。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后白衣女子解释刹那芳华曲与木族圣女、空桑仙子、神农旧情有关，并转入青帝、血书和蜃楼城线索。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32 in all current and flashback material, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute, and right-waist green bamboo sheath holding hidden broken Wufeng.
Shennong appears as an aged mythic ruler/healer in purple or ancient dignified robes, physically weakened by poison yet spiritually immense; avoid comic or ordinary old-man styling.
White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, water/rain-associated, fully clothed, and emotionally restrained until the Shennong/Chana Fanghua reaction.
Use flashback imagery as cinematic memory fragments rather than literal explanatory panels; no on-screen words, no readable blood letter, no lyrics, no floating labels.
Setting alternates between current moonlit Tianhu bamboo lakeside and memory fragments of Nanjishan cliff, Dragon Tooth Rock, waterfall spray, and Dragon Pool.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, plaques, UI, clear inscriptions, or visible song title.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no flute/xiao audio, no heartbeat audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, music, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable recollection, restrained reaction, mist, robe, waterfall spray, and light movement. Avoid lip-sync, fast body turns, readable letters, and musical-note graphics.

suggested_shots.title: 一五一十诉旧事
suggested_shots.visual_focus: At the moonlit Tianhu lakeside, adult Tuobaye begins recounting the story with the green bamboo flute near his hand; the white-clothed woman listens intently, sensing the name behind the tune.

suggested_shots.title: 南际山遇神农
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Memory fragment: adult-adapted Tuobaye encounters the poisoned aged Shennong on the Nanjishan cliff near waterfall spray, with late-sunset or storm-lit mythic atmosphere.

suggested_shots.title: 临终重托坠龙潭
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Memory fragment: Shennong entrusts a sealed blood letter or relic bundle without readable content; Tuobaye is later shown falling through waterfall mist toward Dragon Pool, abstract and safe.

suggested_shots.title: 闻毒与芳华动容
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Back at Tianhu, the white-clothed woman reacts to Shennong's poison death and the Chana Fanghua tune; her eyes glisten while Tuobaye watches, unsure what old grief he has touched.

next_work: Create SSJ_EP02_SC12 storyboard plan with 4 shots, each 8-10 seconds max.
Use visual cross-cutting between present reaction and memory fragments; avoid explanatory text panels.
Do not render blood letter contents, lyrics, song title, 神农, 空桑, 木族, 刹那芳华, or any readable Chinese/English text.
Use silent/no-caption/no-readable-text I2V prompts. Do not generate speech, lip-sync, flute/xiao audio, or musical notes inside video.
If Gemini file_ids I2V remains rejected and no Runway key exists, use technical still fallback only for continuity and mark every output as non-production.
